import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,tempfile,time
import cacheweft
from cacheweft import Cache,Spec
from cacheweft.http import HTTPS
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from tests.fixture import Origin,DATA
root=pathlib.Path(cacheweft.__file__).parent
result={'runtime_core_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'core.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'leases_after_gc':[],'work_after_gc':[]}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cw-lease-',dir='/tmp') as tmp:
    base=pathlib.Path(tmp);origin=Origin(base/'tls');digest=hashlib.sha256(DATA).hexdigest()
    try:
        with Cache(base/'cache',[Spec('a',origin.url,len(DATA),digest)],HTTPS(origin.origin,'127.0.0.1',origin.cert),manifest_revision=1) as c:
            for i in range(8):
                c.submit('r'+str(i),'a',seconds=3,epoch=c.epoch);status=c.wait('r'+str(i));assert status['request']['state']=='SUCCEEDED'
                with c.read(digest) as file:assert file.read()==DATA
                c.futures[digest].result(3);time.sleep(.02)
                c.gc(c.gc_plan())
                result['leases_after_gc'].append(len(c.leases));result['work_after_gc'].append(len(c.work))
            result['requests_retained']=c.db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM requests').fetchone()[0]
    finally:origin.close()
print(json.dumps(result))
